Title: Frontend Developer
Requirements:
- B.Tech/B.E. in CSE or IT
- Minimum 1 year of frontend development experience
- Must have strong expertise in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML, and CSS
- Strong knowledge of responsive web design and state management
Bonus:
- Experience with Redux Toolkit, web performance optimization, and Storybook is preferred
- Knowledge of GraphQL or Jest is a plus
